reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that aggregates session usage data and presents token statistics, activity heatmaps, insights, and model rankings in a Settings dashboard.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的设置页面中汇总会话用量，并以统计卡片、活动热力图、洞察指标和模型排名展示 Token 使用情况。
summaries.en: Aggregates DeepSeek Harness session usage and displays token statistics through cards, activity heatmaps, insights, and model rankings in the Settings dashboard.

capabilities: Reads historical and live session usage events
Aggregates token, request, model, session, and duration statistics
Persists usage aggregates to a local snapshot file
Exposes local statistics endpoints and renders a settings dashboard
